description:
FILED s519b (Opus 5.5, s520, 2026-10-18) from the IO-Compress board census (112utf8-zip.t dies "Not a HASH reference" at row 7 of 29: `push @efs, $u->getHeaderInfo()->{efs};`, IO::Uncompress::Base::getHeaderInfo is `wantarray ? @{ *$self->{InfoList} } : *$self->{Info}`).

SILENT WRONG / CRASH: the CALL whose result is dereferenced by a postfix `->{...}` / `->[...]` is called in the ENCLOSING list context; perl calls it in SCALAR context (the arrow's operand is a scalar).  Pre-existing: identical on main fd04c048.

Reproducer (perl 5.40.3 vs PCL):
  package U; sub new { bless {Info => {efs => 1}, L => [{efs=>1},{efs=>2}]}, shift }
  sub gh { my $self = shift; wantarray ? @{ $self->{L} } : $self->{Info} }
  package main; my $u = U->new;
  sub f { wantarray ? ({efs=>7},{efs=>8}) : {efs=>9} }
  my $v = $u->gh->{efs}; print "scalar: $v\n";              # perl 1, PCL 1
  my @a = ($u->gh->{efs}); print "list-assign: @a\n";       # perl 1, PCL dies "Not a HASH reference"
  print "print: ", $u->gh()->{efs}, "\n";                   # perl 1, PCL dies
  print "func: ", f()->{efs}, "\n";                         # perl 9, PCL (f in list context)
Emission: `(p-gethash-deref (p-list-ctx (p-method-call $u "gh")) "efs")` -- the context bind of the enclosing list slot is put on the deref's OPERAND; the operand of an arrow deref (and of `${ EXPR }` / `@{ EXPR }` / `%{ EXPR }` with a call inside) must be bound SCALAR, whatever the slot of the whole deref (the scalar-assignment spelling already gets `(p-scalar-ctx ...)`).

FIX SHAPE: in Pl/ExprToCL.pm, the deref heads (p-gethash-deref / p-aref-deref and their -argbox / chained forms) generate their operand under scalar context -- ONE place where the operand is generated, not per slot (rule 11; grep the producer of `(p-list-ctx` around a deref operand).  BAR: the four probe lines = perl; IO-Compress 112utf8-zip.t past row 7 (one-file `tools/run-dist-t.pl --rows`); corpus-diff (the emission changes wherever a call result is dereferenced in a list slot -- every differing file explained); a guard row; the sweep.


=== DONE (s521a, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-18) ===
Commit c5bc1627.  NOT in ExprToCL: the context is decided ONCE in Pl/PExpr.pm `child_context` -- child 0 of `a_ref_acc` / `h_ref_acc` is SCALAR (after the list-slice rule, which keeps `(f())[0]->{k}` LIST), and a prefix_op sigil cast (`$ @ % & $#`) gives its operand SCALAR.  ir-spec §4.1 bullet.
Probes (scratch/s521a/pr/m2a.pl, 16 spellings incl. the task's four, `@{ f() }` `%{ f() }` `${ f() }[1]` `$#{ f() }`, chained, as a sub argument, in a `return` list, a method chain, `scalar(f())->{k}`, `(f())[0]->{k}`) all = perl; `&w(1)`, `&$c()`, `(&{$c})` keep list context (m2b.pl).
corpus-diff vs ed8a4504: grep postfixderef push recurse ref state -- the operand's p-list-ctx / p-void-ctx / bare call -> p-scalar-ctx, and a list slice under a deref gains p-list-scalar (identity for one index); eab: autodie Digest::MD5 mro version Compress::Raw::Zlib, same shape, RCDIFF 0.  Guard Pl/t/bind-operand-ctx-01.t rows 10-11 (row 10 FAILS on a5885afc).  IO-Compress 112utf8-zip.t 7 -> 20 of 29 (next stop Test::Builder->details = #3495).  Sweep clean.
subject: A call whose result is dereferenced by ->{...} / ->[...] runs in the ENCLOSING list context, perl calls it in SCALAR context -- (p-gethash-deref (p-list-ctx CALL) ...): a wantarray-aware accessor returns its list and the deref dies "Not a HASH reference" (IO-Compress 112utf8-zip.t getHeaderInfo()->{efs})
